title: (No AI) David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
content:
![A man wearing a brown shirt and a puka shell necklace sitting with his legs crossed in a cluttered office.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/UFP25_R4_Rec709_2p4gamma_6188x3240_20260828.0363314_R2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=20.001873779297,0,79.998126220703,100)

Though [David Fincher](https://www.theverge.com/streaming/1004323/netflix-david-fincher-shawn-levy-mike-flanagan-duffer-brothers-greta-gerwig)'s fans had been eagerly anticipating _The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth_, early screenings of the _Once Upon a Time in Hollywood_ sequel starring Brad Pitt have raised questions about whether generative AI was used in the film. People have claimed that the movie is chock-full of uncanny, inconsistent visuals that make it feel more like slop than the sort of polished film you'd expect from the director of sleek productions like _Fight Club_ and _The Social Network_.

title: (No AI) Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Colorful graphic of Tidal logo](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25319678/STK301_Tidal_01.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, [according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen](https://x.com/rsa/status/2125227949163180409?a=_ijAsgwhi7yghNH90mc&s=20).

The move comes just months after [Tidal began labeling and demonetizing tracks](https://www.theverge.com/tech/959211/tidal-ai-music-policy-demonetizingdetect-label) identified as 100 percent AI-generated. In a post on X, Andersen says Tidal needed to take a more "drastic" measure, as AI music made up 43 percent of the tracks distributed to the platform in the last 90 days. "We believe this will resonate with both artists and listeners alike, as 96% of all AI-generated songs recei …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/1041362/tidal-ai-music-ban)
